lines.text: Page and stamp together. Keep moving.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Process servers. They stand and wait while it's read.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Pull it, Wallit.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Pull the lever. The belt stops. The Crew stops.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Refused. Mine to refuse.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Ring's staked. I'm coming.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Say it.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Second ring holds. Next.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Seventy metres. Then back.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Slice. This is the circle: the one address in the Hollow that's filed. Inside it, things exist.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Spare parts. Spare orders.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Spider. It carries the order.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Still here. Plate's cracked.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Still standing.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Swing it.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Tch. Plated.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: That is how it's done. Refuse the paper, and it has to strike.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The circle's yours. The lease is paid. Board.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The Clearing Crew. Stamped out here, one batch for every unfiled thing in the Hollow.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The Clearing Floor. The chirpy ones are stamped out there, one batch for every unfiled thing in the Hollow.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The Courier. It reads the order out, then it lands.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The Floor sends the same unit again, heavier, when the cheap ones fail.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The Foreman. It reads the order to the Crew. Don't let it finish.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The last word was a ball. Good.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The order. It comes down the path, last. Hold the circle until it does.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The Plated Alpha. Plate says invalid.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The Registrar. It reads the pages with every leg. Break it before it signs.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The room is blank. Nothing left to read.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The Server. It will not strike until it has offered the paper three times and been refused three times.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The wall is gone. The circle is brighter.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Their own pay. A Yo Bot is held together by its wages.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Then answer it. Board.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Then pay with swings.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Then we collect.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: They aren't. They're what the Yo Bots are for.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: They know mine.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Third hits. All twelve.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Three knocks on record. They will remember.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Three refusals on the record. It has nothing left but force.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Tougher. I'm fine.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words
